answer: Require a DNA marker-panel check: each identity mails a saliva sample to a certified lab, which sequences the panel and registers its hash. One genome per identity, one berth per ship, like a wharf; duplicates are rejected. At $99 per test, 100 fakes cost $9,900 and 1,000 cost $99,000, plus one living person per fake, so the registry stays a haven for real agents, each proven by an ivory-sealed lab report.
